FIRST-IN

Build what you want. Learn what you built.

Describe an app in one sentence. A language model running on your own machine builds it and runs it in your browser. Then learn the generated code chapter by chapter, with short interactive lessons, earning XP as you go.

Get started View on GitHub
What it does

From one prompt to code you actually understand

Prompt to app

One sentence in, a working self-contained app out, rendered live in the page and downloadable as a single HTML file.

Learn your own code

The generated code is split into chapters: structure, styling, functions. Each one becomes a short lesson about code you created.

XP and ranks

Every correct answer earns XP. Your rank climbs across projects, and lesson difficulty adapts to it, from plain language to real challenges.

Interactive exercises

Tap shuffled tokens to rebuild a real line from your project, or answer a focused multiple-choice question. Short, concrete, never generic.

Keep working on it

Tell the model what to change, in plain words. It rewrites the project, your learning progress is kept, and undo is one click away.

Local and private

Inference runs on your machine through Ollama. No cloud services, no API keys, no accounts. English and Hebrew interface.

How it works

Three steps, one loop

1

Describe

Write what you want to build: a game, a tool, anything that fits in a page.

2

The model builds

In about two minutes you have a working app, running right there in the browser.

3

Learn the code

Open the project map and work through the chapters. Each lesson shows the idea, a real code example, then an exercise.

Lessons

Show the idea, then test it

Every chapter opens with a short concept card and one to three real lines from your own code, syntax highlighted. Then the exercise: rebuild a line by tapping tokens in order, or pick the right answer about what the code does.

  • Beginner lessons use everyday words and a single line of code
  • Higher ranks get consequence questions about edge cases
  • Wrong answers get gentle retries; first-try answers earn bonus XP
Get started

Running locally in three commands

1 Clone and install

git clone https://github.com/yairrrr/first-in.git
cd first-in
npm install

2 Start the app

npm run dev

Open http://localhost:5173 and check demo mode to explore a recorded project with zero extra setup.

3 Real builds (optional, needs Ollama)

ollama pull gemma4:12b

With Ollama running, the model builds and revises projects from your prompts. Requires roughly 8 GB of free memory.

Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer, npm, and any modern browser. Everything is stored locally in your browser; there is no server and nothing leaves your machine.
